later_events.mechanism: transfer of tracts of land in Puerto Rico acquired under EO 7057 from the Secretary of the Interior to the Secretary of Agriculture (EO 10018, signed 1948-11-15; does not name Davis and does not end the appointment)

clauses.mechanism: successor appointed vice the incumbent Administrator, 'resigned', with the same four earlier orders amended accordingly (EO 10468)
clauses.reason: EO 9901 (signed "October 25, 1947.") appoints James P. Davis as Administrator of the Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration, "vice Edwin G. Arnold, resigned, to serve" without additional compensation and to exercise the functions conferred by Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689, which "The said Executive orders are hereby" amended accordingly. EO 10468, signed "July 7,1953." (18 FR, issue of July 9, 1953), appoints William C. Strand as Administrator, "James P. Davis, resigned, to serve with" the same terms, gives him the functions conferred by the same four orders, and amends them accordingly. EO 10468 therefore shows that Davis had resigned and had been replaced no later than July 7, 1953, when the functions conferred on him were conferred on his successor. The date of Davis's resignation is not held and may be earlier; July 7, 1953 is the latest date by which his appointment and functions had ended and the first date on which a held instrument documents the end, so it is recorded as the first end with that qualification. The appointing words were performed on signing, October 25, 1947; that earlier date is an alternative candidate for the end of the appointing act alone, but the clause also confers functions on the appointee during his service. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of EO 10468 (its provision quoted by the dossier's change record). EO 10018 (1948-11-15) is not an end of this clause.

research_rationale:
EO 9901 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9901.txt, 12 FR 6965, PDF page 1); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order appoints James P. Davis, Director, Division of Territories and Island Possessions, Department of the Interior, as Administrator of the Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration, vice Edwin G. Arnold, resigned, to serve without additional compensation, and to exercise the functions conferred on the Administration and the Administrator by Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689, which it amends accordingly. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The appointment is ended by a held successor order that appoints another Administrator 'vice' Davis and amends the same four orders.

savings.reason: EO 10468 conferred the same functions, duties and authority under Executive Orders 7057, 7180 (as amended by 7554) and 7689 on William C. Strand, so what the order gave Davis was transferred to his successor; acts done by Davis as Administrator before then are accrued. No held source shows any continuing command of EO 9901 after that transfer.
